why: Dean, 8 Sep 2026: the packs must hold the bangers an Australian pub crowd knows from the first few seconds, not tracks nobody in the room has heard. The 10 Aug 2026 bulk load of 12,880 singalong tracks filled every tail with material that fails that test. Ranked on ARIA year-end charts 1955-2026, Australian number ones 1950s-2026 and the triple j Hottest 100 1989-2025, plus enduring pub singalongs. Songs cut from a pack stay in the songs array, so putting one back is a one-line edit here.
